items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I was playing in Zack White's band in Wheeling one night so the guys asked me to come up and sing.

ctx.x: That's right, that's right. We did a lot of one nighter's around New England. In fact, I joined the band in New England, you know. That's where I joined them. I was playing in Zack White's band in Wheeling one night so the guys asked me to come up and sing. So I said sure I'll sing. So I went up and I sang the "Kiss Waltz" because the band played waltzes in those days too, you know.
